description: A test script for verifying cherry-pick and revert operations on root commits in Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock for reproducibility.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings for equality in tests.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given file path no longer exists.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.
